changes_made.explanation: Normalized datasets to remove redundant/overly specific entries. Simplified models list to main model types (SEN2SEN, CONCAT, Transformer) rather than detailed variants. Added missing IWSLT13 De-En dataset.

Simplified metrics by removing redundant entries (F1 score → F1) and removing AutoPRF which is mentioned briefly but not used as a primary evaluation metric. Kept core metrics: BLEU, F1, Precision, Recall.
No LLM evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper only uses traditional automatic metrics and focuses on pronoun translation improvement.
The paper does not conduct any human evaluation. It only uses automatic metrics for evaluation.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on improving pronoun translation in machine translation using hybrid losses and targeted fine-tuning. The extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant or overly specific items that were simplified. The paper evaluates primarily with BLEU and pronoun translation metrics (F1, precision, recall) but does not use LLM or human evaluation.
